API Reference › Response Review and Stats

response_review_stats.analysisRun.summarizeMetrics

Compute grouped metric counts and finite means.

Syntax

function summary = summarizeMetrics(metrics)

Description

summary = response_review_stats.analysisRun.summarizeMetrics(metrics) accepts a metric table. Rows group by pairId when present, otherwise by SegmentName, otherwise as "all". PeakToPeak/peakToPeak and SNR_dB/snrDb spellings are accepted. The output table contains Group, Count, MeanPeakToPeak, and MeanSnrDb. Empty/non-table input returns one "all" row with count zero and NaN means. Non-finite metrics are omitted. No inferential statistics or weighting are applied.

Related APIs

  • response_review_stats.analysisRun.alignSegments — Interpolate segment traces to a shared time grid.
  • response_review_stats.analysisRun.measureAlignedSegments — Measure peak-to-peak, noise, and SNR per segment.
